Village.","source_id":"SYNTHESIZED_OPENER","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":0},{"text":"When you're ready, head for 29 Washington Place — about a 4-minute walk from here.","source_id":"GLUE_NAV","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":0},{"text":"Look up at the corner of Washington Place and Greene Street, where the fire tore through the upper floors.","source_id":"GLUE_STAGING","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":0},{"text":"On March 25, 1911, a fire on this site killed 146 people and reshaped New York State law and the whole history of the American labor movement.","source_id":"d2822b05-797f-4868-926f-012e3c3179d2","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"That Saturday, some 600 young women were at work in a garment factory on the eighth, ninth, and tenth floors — most of them Jewish and Italian immigrants, between 13 and 23.","source_id":"d2822b05-797f-4868-926f-012e3c3179d2","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"At five, just as they got ready to leave, fire sprang up in the southeast corner of the eighth floor, and no one has ever learned how it started.","source_id":"d2822b05-797f-4868-926f-012e3c3179d2","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"Within minutes all three floors were an inferno — and an inescapable one, because many of the doors had been locked from the outside, to stop theft, the owners later said.","source_id":"d2822b05-797f-4868-926f-012e3c3179d2","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"A fire escape collapsed, and the elevator operator fled.","source_id":"d2822b05-797f-4868-926f-012e3c3179d2","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"But a man on the street named Joseph Zito ran in, got the elevator working, and rode it up through the flames five times, carrying 25 or 30 workers out on every trip.","source_id":"d2822b05-797f-4868-926f-012e3c3179d2","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"Even so, some of the young women jumped to their deaths in front of horrified passersby, others suffocated, and some were crushed against those locked doors.","source_id":"d2822b05-797f-4868-926f-012e3c3179d2","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"Most of them died in the first ten minutes of an hour-long blaze at the Triangle Shirt Waist Factory.","source_id":"d2822b05-797f-4868-926f-012e3c3179d2","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"After many protests, the state legislature answered by rewriting its labor code into the most stringent in the nation.","source_id":"57123952-8db2-40d5-8c30-421ae6789bb4","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"The labor movement had been struggling until then; now it gathered steam, and the International Ladies Garment Workers Union — the ILGWU — became a force in the industry.","source_id":"57123952-8db2-40d5-8c30-421ae6789bb4","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"That's 29 Washington Place — where 146 deaths changed the law.","source_id":"GLUE_CLOSING","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":0}]}
